thread:
anya - PM: Quick thread to create a lean risk/benefit rubric for Optimize recommendations rollout (batching, caching, quant). Need unambiguous pass/fail gates.

sam - Eng: Agreed. Propose three axis: Quality (concordance), Economics (token savings), Stability (error/SLO impact). Each axis gets a hard threshold and a warning band.

li - ML: My suggestion for Quality: concordance delta <= 1.25% pass, 1.25-2.0% warning, >2.0% fail. Use customer canonical prompts and semantic similarity checks.

maria - Solutions: For Economics: require >=7% token savings median to pass, 4-7% warning, <4% fail. Also show ROI projection in the explainer payload.

sam - Eng: Stability: p95 latency delta <= +5% pass, +5-10% warning, >10% fail. Error rate increase <=0.05% pass, <=0.2% warning, >0.2% fail.

eng-obs: We'll surface these as dashboard tiles with green/yellow/red and a per-tenant summary row. Also include a one-click pause and audit trail.

alex - Legal: Note: for regulated tenants (health/finance) we should default to explicit opt-in and add consent logging. Also keep an audit export for compliance.

anya - PM: Good catch. Add a policy: regulated vertical = opt-in only, non-regulated = opt-out with 7-day notice. Document in pilot onboarding pack.

li - ML: Operational detail: add a sample-level suppression for quant recs when token-level surprisal spikes; treat that as immediate local fail for that request.

sam - Eng: Implementation: runtime tags recs with metadata {quant, batch, cache, explain_id}. eng-obs can join on explain_id to show per-recommendation metrics.

maria - Solutions: Customer-facing package: short explainer JSON (reason, estimated savings, risk band, sample baseline vs candidate), daily digest email for pilots, and a one-click opt-out.

devops-bot: deploy 1765435140 -> canary to optimize-pilot pool (tags: int8, conservative-cache)

anya - PM: Acceptance flow: alpha internal -> closed pilot (3 customers) -> extended pilot (10) -> GA opt-in. To graduate each stage require 72h of green status with no warning-level triggers.

sam - Eng: Rollback SLA: automated rollback within 15 minutes on fail; ops runbook to notify tenant + open incident for >30 minutes unresolved. Will add feature flag per-tenant.

alex - Legal: Also require retention policy: per-tenant explain logs retained 90 days, telemetry aggregates retained per existing policy.

anya - PM: Actions & owners:
- maria: draft pilot onboarding + explainer templates by Tue (owner: maria)
- sam: runtime tagging + feature flags by Fri (owner: sam)
- li: concordance metric spec + surprisal filter by Thu (owner: li)
- eng-obs: dashboard prototype by Mon (owner: eng-obs)

maria - Solutions: ack. I'll prioritize customers that can provide canonical prompts and KPI proxies.

li - ML: ack. I'll push a short doc with metric calc and sample thresholds.

anya - PM: Reconvene next Wed 10:30 to review pilot readiness. Keep the rubric strict and easy to automate. :thumbsup:
